title: Gnome Totem
description: This is a resource pack that allows you to rename your totem of undying to 'Gnome of Undying' and it will be retextured to a gnome! When in 3rd Person the gnome appears sitting on your shoulder. idk why I made this
body: A texturepack that adds a gnome texture to a Totem of Undying! Rename your totem to 'Gnome of Undying' to have the texture work.
